digest.component_or_area: dependency graph resolver and link validation
propositions: rebar link can record a different edge than requested and produce edges where a ticket blocks its own subtree, distorting ready/next-batch ordering and cascade semantics

comparability for blocking links must be decided by parent hierarchy position (nearest-common-ancestor) rather than ticket TYPE_TIER, so genuine siblings can hold direct dependencies regardless of type
no blocking edge can exist between a ticket and its own ancestor or descendant, enforced structurally in the resolver rather than as a fallback guard
legacy blocking edges written under the type-tier rule must be detectable store-wide and repairable in a single pass without changing the auto-escalation contract
the quiet parameter in rebar.link() and composer.link_core() silently discards escalation redirect records visible on the CLI path, leaving MCP and library callers unaware of substituted edges
